summary_en: OSG Corporation executed a block purchase of 1,368,700 shares at 3,653 yen per share on October 13, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3, totaling approximately 5.0 billion yen, representing 1.64% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice of Share Acquisition via Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 9, 2026, OSG Corporation's board of directors authorized the execution of a share buyback as a block transaction within the broader authorization approved on the same date. The company executed the purchase of 1,368,700 shares at 3,653 yen per share (the closing price on October 9, 2026) via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on October 13, 2026 at 8:45 AM. The total purchase amount was approximately 5.0 billion yen, representing 1.64% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

This block execution was conducted under the broader buyback authorization of up to 1,500,000 shares for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen, approved for the period from October 13 to November 30, 2026. Following completion of this ToSTNeT-3 purchase, the company planned to proceed with open market purchases for the remaining portion of the authorized buyback amount.

The purchase was executed as a time-limited order during the specified ToSTNeT-3 trading session, and results were publicly disclosed upon completion of the transaction.
